run_prepare_co3d: run the prepare_co3d script with --co3d_path to cache CO3D dataset splits as PyTorch files
build_co3d_dataset_cache: build a dataset cache by running prepare_co3d.py with the path to a CO3D dataset directory
create_seq_name2idx_mapping: create a sequence name to index mapping for CO3D dataset frame annotations across train and val splits
summarize_main: summarize the main function that iterates CO3D categories, loads dataset maps, and saves cached .pt files
review_main: review the main function that processes CO3D dataset categories and caches train and val splits using torch.save
